title: From Debate to Decision: Conformal Social Choice for Safe Multi-Agent Deliberation
abstract: arXiv:2604.07667v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-agent debate improves LLM reasoning, yet agreement is not evidence of correctness. When agents converge on a wrong answer through social reinforcement, consensus stopping commits that error to automated action with no recourse. We introduce Conformal Social Choice, a post-hoc layer that converts debate outputs into calibrated act-versus-escalate decisions. Verbalized probability distributions from heterogeneous agents are aggregated via a linear opinion pool and calibrated with split conformal prediction, yielding fixed-round marginal coverage: at any pre-specified round, the correct answer is included with probability ${\geq}\,1{-}\alpha$, without assumptions on individual model calibration. A hierarchical action policy maps singletons to autonomous action and larger sets to human escalation. translated_title: 从辩论到决策：面向安全多智能体审议的共形社会选择
translated_abstract: 多智能体辩论能够提升大语言模型的推理能力，但达成一致并不意味着答案正确。当各智能体通过社会性强化在错误答案上达成共识时，基于共识的停止机制会将该错误直接付诸自动化行动，且无从挽回。我们提出“共形社会选择”，这是一个事后处理层，可将辩论输出转化为经过校准的“自主执行还是上报人工”决策。来自异构智能体的口头化概率分布通过线性意见池进行聚合，并使用分裂共形预测进行校准，从而获得固定轮次的边际覆盖率保证：在任何预先指定的轮次上，正确答案以 ≥1−α 的概率被包含在候选集合中，且无需对单个模型的校准性做任何假设。分层动作策略将单元素候选集映射为自主行动，将更大的候选集映射为升级至人工处理。在八个 MMLU-Pro 领域及两个额外基准测试上，固定轮次的覆盖率始终接近目标水平。核心发现并不是辩论……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出共形社会选择这一事后校准层，通过线性意见池聚合与分裂共形预测校准多智能体辩论的口头化概率输出，保证在任意指定轮次正确答案以 ≥1−α 的概率被覆盖，从而在自主执行与人工上报之间实现安全决策。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Conformal Social Choice, a post-hoc layer that aggregates verbalized probabilities from multi-agent debate via a linear opinion pool and split conformal calibration, guaranteeing ≥1−α coverage of the correct answer at any pre-specified round to safely decide between autonomous action and human escalation.
